description: This file defines the AnnouncementStore class for managing announcements in the Notesnook web application, including methods for refreshing and dismissing announcements, and logic for determining whether to show announcements based on platform, app version, and user status.

classes.name: AnnouncementStore
classes.description: Class extending BaseStore to manage inline and dialog announcements, with methods to refresh and dismiss announcements.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches announcements from the database, filters them based on visibility criteria, and updates the store state.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Marks an announcement as removed in the configuration and deletes it from the store's announcement lists.
